veranderings.na: Dit bestaan uit baie aparte dele.
veranderings.rede: 'Dit is baie dele' is wooden; 'bestaan uit' is natural, and 'los' can read as 'loose', which clashes with 'stewig aanmekaar vas' two sentences later.
Same reason as above: 'los' suggests loose parts, while the lesson says the parts are firmly joined; 'aparte' keeps the meaning of separate pieces.

veranderings.voor: Tussen die dele is daar oop plek.
veranderings.na: Tussen die dele is daar oop plekke.
veranderings.rede: Plural matches the definition just above ('met oop plekke tussen hulle') and reads more naturally for several gaps.

veranderings.voor: druk sy gewig van bo op die been en die grond van onder af terug
veranderings.na: druk sy gewig van bo af op die been, en die grond druk van onder af terug
veranderings.rede: The elided verb makes the second clause hard to parse; 'van bo af' parallels 'van onder af', and the two full clauses take the AWS comma before 'en'.

veranderings.voor: 'n Haai se geraamte is nie been nie, maar kraakbeen.
veranderings.na: 'n Haai se geraamte bestaan nie uit been nie, maar uit kraakbeen.
veranderings.rede: A skeleton is not 'been' but is made of it; 'bestaan uit' states the material correctly.

veranderings.blok: Wat die raam vir die dier doen
veranderings.voor: kan jy tussen die ribbes van die ribbekas deurkyk, en ook
veranderings.na: kan jy tussen die ribbes van die ribbekas deurkyk en ook
veranderings.rede: The 'en ook' phrase has no subject or verb of its own, so per AWS 2017 no comma before 'en'.

veranderings.voor: wat 'n raam binne 'n ander dier doen
veranderings.na: wat 'n raam binne-in 'n ander dier doen
veranderings.rede: 'binne-in' is the form the lesson uses everywhere else for inside the body, and reads more naturally here.
'nou' reads as a time word (as if the strength moved); 'hier' means 'in this case', which is the intended contrast.

veranderings.voor: Sy nuwe dop is eers sag en hy rek
veranderings.na: Sy nuwe dop is eers sag, en hy rek
veranderings.rede: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires a comma.

veranderings.na: Dan word die nuwe dop hard
veranderings.rede: 'Daardie dop' could point back to the old shell just mentioned; 'die nuwe dop' makes the reference clear and the word order is more natural.

vlae.teks: 'n sterk buitekant om die ruimte binne, wat sy eie vorm hou sonder 'n raam daarbinne
vlae.rede: 'om die ruimte binne' is wooden (something like 'rondom die ruimte binne-in' reads better), but the same wording stands in the study text and the glossary definition, so it should be changed in both together, not by one script edit; left for the reviewer or writer to decide.
